definition: An officer in the army, navy, or police.
examples: The lieutenant gave the order.
My uncle was a lieutenant in the navy.
Lieutenant Davis is on the phone.

spanish.definition: Oficial del ejército, la marina o la policía.

definition: A high officer in the army.
examples: The colonel spoke to his men.
Her father was a colonel in the army.
Yes, Colonel, I understand.

spanish.definition: Oficial de alto rango en el ejército.

definition: An officer in the army or police, below a lieutenant.
examples: The sergeant shouted at the soldiers.
He became a police sergeant last year.
Sergeant Lee will take your statement.

spanish.definition: Oficial del ejército o la policía, por debajo de un teniente.

definition: A polite word for speaking to a woman.
examples: Can I help you, madam?
This way, madam.
Excuse me, madam, is this your bag?

spanish.definition: Palabra cortés para dirigirse a una mujer.

definition: A person who leads a group of soldiers.
examples: The commander told us to wait.
She is the commander of the ship.
Our commander was very brave.

spanish.definition: Persona que dirige un grupo de soldados.

definition: A person whose job is to check things; a police officer.
examples: The inspector checked the kitchen.
A food inspector visited the restaurant.
The police inspector asked me some questions.

spanish.definition: Persona cuyo trabajo es revisar cosas; oficial de policía.

definition: Used to say what is right or a good idea.
examples: You ought to call your mother.
We ought to leave soon.
He ought to see a doctor.

spanish.definition: Indica lo que es correcto o una buena idea.

definition: All the people who work for a company or place.
examples: The hotel staff was very friendly.
Our school has a staff of forty.
Please ask a staff member.

spanish.definition: Todas las personas que trabajan en una empresa o lugar.

definition: One single thing or group; an amount used for measuring.
examples: A meter is a unit of length.
We finished the first unit of the book.
The police unit arrived quickly.

spanish.definition: Una sola cosa o grupo; cantidad que sirve para medir.

definition: A small copy of something; a person who shows clothes.
examples: He built a model of a ship.
She works as a fashion model.
This is the newest model of the phone.

spanish.definition: Copia pequeña de algo; persona que muestra ropa.

definition: A small metal piece that you turn to hold things; to fix something with one.
examples: This screw is loose.
He screwed the shelf to the wall.
I need a smaller screw.

spanish.definition: Pieza pequeña de metal que se gira para sujetar cosas; fijar algo con ella.

definition: The people who live in one place or share something.
examples: We live in a small community.
She helps people in her community.
The community built a new park.

spanish.definition: Personas que viven en un lugar o comparten algo.

definition: Great sadness, usually after someone dies.
examples: Her grief was very deep.
He couldn't hide his grief.
Grief takes time to go away.

spanish.definition: Tristeza muy grande, normalmente tras una muerte.

definition: A short, high sound from a machine; to make this sound.
examples: Leave a message after the beep.
The microwave beeped twice.
My phone keeps beeping.

spanish.definition: Sonido corto y agudo de una máquina; hacer ese sonido.

definition: A shape with four equal sides; an open area in a town.
examples: Draw a square on the paper.
We met in the main square.
The table is square.

spanish.definition: Figura de cuatro lados iguales; espacio abierto en un pueblo.

definition: A person who kills someone on purpose.
examples: The police caught the murderer.
He's a murderer, and he's dangerous.
The movie is about a murderer in a small town.

spanish.definition: Persona que mata a alguien a propósito.

definition: The quality of being good; a word that shows surprise.
examples: My goodness, you've gotten so tall!
Goodness, it's late!
I believe in the goodness of people.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser bueno; palabra que expresa sorpresa.

definition: To ask God to protect someone or something.
examples: God bless you.
The priest blessed the baby.
Bless you! Do you have a cold?

spanish.definition: Pedir a Dios que proteja a alguien o algo.

definition: Below something else; to move something down.
examples: The prices are lower this week.
He lowered his voice.
Your name is on the lower part of the page.

spanish.definition: Debajo de otra cosa; mover algo hacia abajo.

definition: The hard material that trees are made of.
examples: The table is made of wood.
We need more wood for the fire.
I love the smell of fresh wood.

spanish.definition: Material duro del que están hechos los árboles.

definition: Happy about something.
examples: I'm pleased to meet you.
She was pleased with her grade.
He didn't look very pleased.

spanish.definition: Feliz por algo.

definition: A unit of weight, about 454 grams; money in the UK.
examples: I bought a pound of coffee.
She lost ten pounds last year.
This ticket costs twenty pounds in London.

spanish.definition: Unidad de peso, unos 454 gramos; dinero del Reino Unido.

definition: To need someone or something; to change because of something.
examples: It depends on the weather.
Children depend on their parents.
You can depend on me.

spanish.definition: Necesitar a alguien o algo; cambiar según algo.

definition: A rude or unkind person; a quick, sudden movement.
examples: Don't be such a jerk.
He was a jerk to the waiter.
The bus stopped with a jerk.

spanish.definition: Persona grosera; movimiento rápido y repentino.

definition: To lose blood.
examples: Your nose is bleeding.
He cut his finger and it bled a lot.
The wound bled for ten minutes.

spanish.definition: Perder sangre.

definition: The person who leads a state.
examples: The governor of Texas gave a speech.
She wants to be governor one day.
The governor visited our school.

spanish.definition: Persona que dirige un estado.

definition: To shout in a loud, high voice; a loud, high shout.
examples: The kids screamed with joy.
I heard a scream outside.
Stop screaming at me!

spanish.definition: Gritar con voz fuerte y aguda; grito fuerte y agudo.

definition: From an earlier time, but not now.
examples: She's a former teacher.
I saw my former boss at the store.
The former president wrote a book.

spanish.definition: De un tiempo anterior, pero no de ahora.

definition: You, when you are talking to two or more people.
examples: Help yourselves to some cake.
Did you make it yourselves?
Enjoy yourselves at the party!

spanish.definition: Tú, cuando se habla a dos o más personas.

definition: A person who gives information on the radio or TV.
examples: The radio announcer read the news.
He works as a sports announcer.
The announcer said the game was over.

spanish.definition: Persona que da información en la radio o la televisión.

definition: Happy and cheerful.
examples: Merry Christmas!
They sang a merry song.
It was a merry party.

spanish.definition: Contento y animado.

definition: A small group of soldiers, police, or players.
examples: He's on the football squad.
A police squad came to the house.
Our squad trains every morning.

spanish.definition: Grupo pequeño de soldados, policías o jugadores.

definition: At a time you don't know exactly.
examples: Let's have lunch sometime.
I'll call you sometime next week.
Come and visit us sometime.

spanish.definition: En un momento que no se sabe exactamente.

definition: A person who works.
examples: He's a hard worker.
The factory has two hundred workers.
A worker fixed the road.

spanish.definition: Persona que trabaja.

definition: The sound or act of firing a gun.
examples: We heard a gunshot in the night.
The gunshot woke the whole street.
He died from a gunshot wound.

spanish.definition: Sonido o acción de disparar un arma.

definition: A group of soldiers; soldiers in general.
examples: The troops came home last week.
More troops arrived at the border.
My son is in a Boy Scout troop.

spanish.definition: Grupo de soldados; soldados en general.

definition: To cry loudly; a loud cry.
examples: She sobbed all night.
I could hear him sobbing in his room.
He let out a sob.

spanish.definition: Llorar fuerte; llanto fuerte.

definition: To make a low, angry sound, like a dog; this sound.
examples: The dog growled at me.
I heard a growl behind the door.
My stomach is growling.

spanish.definition: Hacer un sonido bajo y enojado, como un perro; ese sonido.

definition: Great fame and honor.
examples: The team won and enjoyed the glory.
He fought for glory.
She doesn't care about glory or money.

spanish.definition: Gran fama y honor.

definition: The soft part of a body or a fruit.
examples: The knife cut into his flesh.
Lions eat the flesh of other animals.
The flesh of a peach is sweet.

spanish.definition: Parte blanda de un cuerpo o de una fruta.

definition: A member of a senate, a part of the government.
examples: The senator answered the reporters.
She was elected senator in 2020.
I wrote a letter to my senator.

spanish.definition: Miembro del senado, una parte del gobierno.

definition: To speak very quietly; a very quiet voice.
examples: She whispered something in my ear.
Why are you whispering?
He spoke in a whisper.

spanish.definition: Hablar muy bajo; voz muy baja.

definition: To make the short, loud sound of a dog; this sound.
examples: My dog barks at the mailman.
The dogs barked all night.
I heard a loud bark.

spanish.definition: Hacer el sonido corto y fuerte de un perro; ese sonido.

definition: A person who is owned by another person.
examples: He was born a slave.
Slaves had no rights.
The book tells the story of a slave who escaped.

spanish.definition: Persona que es propiedad de otra persona.

definition: A very important nobleman.
examples: The duke lived in a huge castle.
She married a duke.
The duke rode through the town.

spanish.definition: Noble muy importante.

definition: Feeling admiration for something or someone.
examples: I'm really impressed with your work.
She was impressed by his cooking.
The teacher looked impressed.

spanish.definition: Que siente admiración por algo o alguien.

definition: A machine that makes a loud warning sound.
examples: I can hear a police siren.
The ambulance came with its siren on.
The fire siren woke everybody up.

spanish.definition: Aparato que hace un sonido fuerte de aviso.

definition: A violent attack; to attack someone.
examples: He went to jail for assault.
A man assaulted her in the parking lot.
The army began its assault at night.

spanish.definition: Ataque violento; atacar a alguien.

definition: To remember something.
examples: I can't recall his name.
Do you recall what she said?
He recalled the day they met.

spanish.definition: Acordarse de algo.

definition: Very strong or big.
examples: The mighty river runs to the sea.
He hit the ball with a mighty swing.
The mighty army crossed the mountains.

spanish.definition: Muy fuerte o grande.

definition: A part of a road for one line of cars; a small road.
examples: Stay in the right lane.
We walked down a quiet lane.
The highway has four lanes.

spanish.definition: Parte de una carretera para una fila de carros; camino pequeño.

definition: Hurt by a gun, a knife, or a similar thing.
examples: The wounded soldier needed help.
Two men were badly wounded.
She found a wounded bird.

spanish.definition: Lastimado por un arma, un cuchillo o algo parecido.

definition: Who you are as a person.
examples: You're not your usual self today.
She's back to her old self.
He wants to be his best self.

spanish.definition: Quién eres como persona.

definition: Later, after something happens.
examples: We ate dinner and watched a movie afterward.
Soon afterward, she left the country.
He got sick right afterward.

spanish.definition: Más tarde, tras ocurrir algo.

definition: A friend, especially a soldier in your group.
examples: He saved his comrade in the war.
The old soldiers were comrades for life.
She wrote a letter to her comrades.

spanish.definition: Amigo, sobre todo un soldado de tu grupo.

definition: A person who works in someone else's house.
examples: The servant opened the door.
The rich family had ten servants.
He treats her like a servant.

spanish.definition: Persona que trabaja en la casa de otra.

definition: Almost.
examples: We're practically there.
The room was practically empty.
She practically lives at the gym.

spanish.definition: Casi.

definition: All the people born around the same time.
examples: My generation grew up with the internet.
Three generations live in this house.
The recipe passed from generation to generation.

spanish.definition: Todas las personas nacidas por la misma época.

definition: A small wooden house; a room on a ship or plane.
examples: We stayed in a cabin by the lake.
He lives in a cabin in the woods.
The plane's cabin was cold.

spanish.definition: Casa pequeña de madera; cuarto en un barco o avión.

definition: About money.
examples: We have some financial problems.
She needs financial help.
He gives financial advice.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con el dinero.

definition: The business of making things or giving a service.
examples: He works in the movie industry.
The car industry is very big here.
Tourism is an important industry.

spanish.definition: Negocio de fabricar cosas o dar un servicio.

definition: A farm animal with thick wool.
examples: The farmer has fifty sheep.
Sheep eat grass.
I can't sleep, so I'm counting sheep.

spanish.definition: Animal de granja con lana gruesa.

definition: A person who studies science.
examples: She wants to be a scientist.
Scientists found a new planet.
The scientist did a long experiment.

spanish.definition: Persona que estudia la ciencia.

definition: The floor of a ship; a wooden floor outside a house; a set of cards.
examples: We sat on the deck after dinner.
The passengers went up on deck.
Do you have a deck of cards?

spanish.definition: Piso de un barco; piso de madera fuera de una casa; juego de cartas.

definition: A person who loves a team or star; a machine that moves air.
examples: I'm a big fan of that band.
The fans cheered for their team.
Turn on the fan, it's hot in here.

spanish.definition: Persona que ama a un equipo o artista; aparato que mueve el aire.

definition: The written words of a movie or play.
examples: The actor read the script.
She wrote the script for that movie.
He forgot to follow the script.

spanish.definition: Texto escrito de una película u obra.

definition: The name of a product made by a company.
examples: What brand is your phone?
This is my favorite brand of coffee.
I don't care about brands.

spanish.definition: Nombre de un producto hecho por una empresa.

definition: Causing pain.
examples: My knee is very painful.
It was a painful goodbye.
The treatment isn't painful.

spanish.definition: Que causa dolor.

definition: To push air out of your throat with a sudden noise; this noise.
examples: He coughed all night.
That's a bad cough.
She's coughing and sneezing.

spanish.definition: Sacar aire de la garganta con un ruido repentino; ese ruido.

definition: A belief in a god or gods.
examples: We don't talk about religion at dinner.
Religion is important to my family.
What's the main religion in your country?

spanish.definition: Creencia en un dios o en varios dioses.

definition: The power to change what people think or do; to have this power.
examples: Her father had a big influence on her.
The weather influences my mood.
Friends can be a bad influence.

spanish.definition: Poder de cambiar lo que la gente piensa o hace; tener ese poder.

definition: Something you burn to make energy, like gas or coal.
examples: The car ran out of fuel.
Fuel prices went up again.
Wood is a cheap fuel.

spanish.definition: Algo que se quema para producir energía, como gasolina o carbón.

definition: Moving your body to stay healthy; to move your body like this; a practice task.
examples: I exercise three times a week.
Walking is good exercise.
Do exercise four on page ten.

spanish.definition: Mover el cuerpo para estar sano; hacerlo; tarea de práctica.

definition: Nice to look at.
examples: She's a very attractive woman.
This is an attractive offer.
He finds her attractive.

spanish.definition: Agradable a la vista.

definition: A very small thing that makes you sick; a bad computer program.
examples: I caught a virus at school.
The virus spread very fast.
My computer has a virus.

spanish.definition: Cosa muy pequeña que enferma; programa dañino de computadora.

definition: Causing someone great pain on purpose; to do this to someone.
examples: They tortured the prisoner.
This traffic is torture.
Torture is against the law.

spanish.definition: Causar mucho dolor a propósito; hacerle eso a alguien.

definition: Very lucky; holy.
examples: I feel blessed to have you.
We are blessed with good health.
We feel so blessed to live here.

spanish.definition: Muy afortunado; sagrado.

definition: Simple, with nothing added; a large flat area of land.
examples: I like plain white shirts.
She eats plain yogurt.
Horses ran across the plain.

spanish.definition: Simple, sin nada añadido; gran extensión de tierra plana.

definition: Happening a short time ago.
examples: This is a recent photo of me.
In recent years, the town has grown.
Her most recent book is great.

spanish.definition: Que pasó hace poco tiempo.

definition: The sound of a person walking.
examples: I heard footsteps on the stairs.
Her footsteps got closer.
He followed in his father's footsteps.

spanish.definition: Sonido de una persona al caminar.

definition: Very special because of religion.
examples: This is a sacred place.
The cow is a sacred animal in India.
They read from a sacred book.

spanish.definition: Muy especial por motivos religiosos.

definition: What you say before you go to bed.
examples: Goodnight, Mom!
Goodnight, sleep well.
He kissed the kids and said goodnight.

spanish.definition: Lo que se dice antes de irse a la cama.

definition: A machine that can move and do work.
examples: A robot cleans our floors.
The kids built a small robot.
Robots work in that factory.

spanish.definition: Máquina que puede moverse y hacer trabajos.

definition: A clear, hard rock; very fine glass.
examples: She wore a crystal necklace.
The glasses are made of crystal.
Salt forms small crystals.

spanish.definition: Roca dura y transparente; vidrio muy fino.

definition: To say or show that something is true or certain.
examples: Please confirm your email address.
The doctor confirmed the news.
I called to confirm my reservation.

spanish.definition: Decir o mostrar que algo es cierto o seguro.

definition: Splitting something into parts; a part of a company or army.
examples: My son is learning division at school.
She runs the sales division.
Our team plays in the first division.

spanish.definition: Separar algo en partes; parte de una empresa o un ejército.

definition: To rub skin with your nails; a thin cut or mark.
examples: The cat scratched me.
Stop scratching your arm.
There's a scratch on my car.

spanish.definition: Frotar la piel con las uñas; corte o marca fina.

definition: A competition.
examples: She won a singing contest.
I entered a photo contest.
The contest ends on Friday.

spanish.definition: Competencia.

definition: Worth a lot of money; very useful.
examples: This ring is very valuable.
Time is valuable.
She gave me valuable advice.

spanish.definition: Que vale mucho dinero; muy útil.

definition: Far away.
examples: They live in a distant country.
We could hear distant thunder.
He's a distant cousin of mine.

spanish.definition: Que está lejos.

definition: Movement.
examples: The motion of the boat made me sick.
The train was already in motion.
We watched it in slow motion.

spanish.definition: Acción de moverse.

definition: The energy that makes lights and machines work.
examples: The electricity went out last night.
Our electricity bill is very high.
This car runs on electricity.

spanish.definition: Energía que hace funcionar luces y máquinas.

definition: A sea animal with short fur; to close something completely.
examples: We saw a seal at the beach.
She sealed the envelope.
Seal the bag before you put it in the freezer.

spanish.definition: Animal marino de pelo corto; cerrar algo por completo.

definition: A level of quality; normal or usual.
examples: The food here is of a high standard.
This is the standard size.
Her standards are very high.

spanish.definition: Nivel de calidad; normal o habitual.

definition: To be all around something or someone.
examples: Trees surround the house.
The police surrounded the building.
She is surrounded by friends.

spanish.definition: Estar alrededor de algo o alguien.

definition: To tell someone about something.
examples: Please inform me of any changes.
They informed us by email.
He didn't inform his boss.

spanish.definition: Contarle algo a alguien.

definition: Kind and calm; soft, not strong.
examples: He's very gentle with the baby.
There was a gentle wind.
Be gentle with that old book.

spanish.definition: Bondadoso y tranquilo; suave, no fuerte.

definition: Your position in a group; the present state of something.
examples: What's the status of my order?
She wants money and status.
Please check your status online.

spanish.definition: Tu posición en un grupo; estado actual de algo.

definition: A small bag that women carry.
examples: She put her keys in her purse.
I left my purse in the car.
Somebody stole her purse.

spanish.definition: Bolsa pequeña que llevan las mujeres.

definition: To ask for something strongly; to ask for money on the street.
examples: I'm begging you, please stay.
A man was begging outside the store.
She begged him to come back.

spanish.definition: Pedir algo con fuerza; pedir dinero en la calle.
